newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index ends 1996 on upward note.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index ends 1996 on upward note.

text.p: Scattered year-end buying at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) on Tuesday pushed the 20-share index up by 11.71 points to stand at 3114.11, brokers and bourse officials said.
Turnover dropped to 10.814 million shillings on 252,559 shares from 23.233 million shillings traded on 556,485 shares.
Bourse officials said the market was moderately active, with key shares registering marginal price gains.
Uchumi Supermarket traded at 48.50 from 47.75, Barclays Bank gained 50 cents to close at 99.50. Kenya Breweries closed at 50.50 from 50, while Sasini Tea & Coffee eased to close at 59 from 59.50.
Brokers attributed Uchumi's upward movement to panic buying for the bonus shares before February 3 when books will close, coupled with a lack of supply.
The supermarket chain is issuing a bonus of one share for every two.
Oil concern Total Kenya traded 40,400 shares at 65 unchanged while Firestone East Africa gained 50 cents to close at 27.50.
Some brokers said at the 60-70 price level, Total was appealing because it was now trading at an affordable level.
"Also you've got to remember that many investors would rather bank on something they know better," one broker said.
"Many of them are still hesitant about trading in Kenya Oil Company. They've adopted a watch and wait attitude," he added.
Foreign investors traded 4,700 shares of National Industrial Credit at 41 from 40.75 and 5,100 shares of Kenya Power & Lighting at 141 from 140.
